finding.title: Persist ambiguous-turn recovery marker before sending turn/start
finding.trigger: Controller process terminates after turn/start can reach server but before its response returns; tools may already have side effects.
finding.failure: Initial repair persisted running only after response. A queued/missing main_runs record survives restart without conversion to interrupted, enabling same inbox message to start again. Old source recorded running before turn/start.
finding.evidence: sessions.py:41 converts only running to interrupted; gateway.py:164-171 only rejects failed/interrupted; controller reconsiders pending messages.
finding.fix_observed: Current gateway.py:275-282 comments and writes running durably before awaiting client.turn_start. Proven unsent/explicit rejection still reaches the existing GatewayNotStartedError path and queued status.
finding.status: source_fix_observed; parent regression execution and deployment verification required
finding.regression: tests/test_app_gateway.py:110 test_crash_after_turn_send_cannot_replay_on_restart uses independent SQLite read before response, simulates BaseException, reconstructs MainSessionRouter and asserts interrupted plus no replay. Test design reviewed, not run by this reviewer.

supported_checks.assessment: RequestNotSentError is raised before transport.send when reader is closed. Ordinary send/response loss is not converted to proven-unsent. Explicit turn/start JSON-RPC capacity rejection is eligible; after-start errors remain nonretriable and ledger-fenced.

Classifier uses structured codexErrorInfo/data or strict capacity messages, rather than arbitrary substring. Quota/general errors are not granted retry permission. Started capacity failures set cooldown but do not replay the started work.

supported_checks.area: quota read timeout and serial lock
supported_checks.assessment: Quota initialization/read runs inside async-with serial lock, each RPC uses bounded startup timeout, closes failed client and propagates. Lock releases during exception unwinding. Lock acquisition itself intentionally waits for current work; this review does not claim quota reads interrupt active work.
supported_checks.source: gateway.py:319-339 (line numbers may shift after P1 fix); tests/test_app_gateway.py test_stalled_quota_read_releases_serial_gateway

supported_checks.assessment: Unknown requests carrying an id are explicitly rejected with JSON-RPC -32601, with method/id/thread/turn-only log, then started turn is interrupted/closed and requires reconciliation. No blanket approval or permissions grant.

GatewayNotStartedError retains queued ledger status and persisted node cooldown; controls remain handled before cooldown. Failed/interrupted main messages return recovery_required without launching a model when retried by inbox scheduler.
